title: September 2026 – OncLive
summary: Meredith Pelster, MD, MSCI, a medical oncologist and associate director of gastrointestinal cancer research at Sarah Cannon Research Institute, discussed the design of the phase 3 MAPKeeper 301 trial (NCT07562152) evaluating the MEK inhibitor atebimetinib (IMM-1-104) in combination with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic pancreatic cancer, as well as the broader landscape of MAP kinase–directed therapy in the disease.
